name: Palomera (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over purple, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Palomera (a dovecote, a river and a scroll on blue and red).
history: Municipal flag of Palomera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Palomera arms — dovecote, river and scroll
